endpoints.description: New. The revision token the NCR page polls every 30 seconds (spec 125 FR-032). Read-only.
endpoints.auth: Session (auth.ensureAuthenticated) and the existing NCR read permission used by GET /ncrs/:id.

200.event_count: number — count of events, so an appended event changes the token even when updated_at does not

responses.403: No read access to the NCR.

endpoints.semantics: The client compares the response with the last one. Only when status, updated_at or event_count changed, and the page has no unsaved entry or open dialog, does it fetch the fragment.

endpoints.description: New. The NCR page body rendered by views/ncr-detail-body.jade, for the page to swap in place (spec 125 FR-032, FR-033). Same rendering as the full page, without the layout.

responses.403: No read access to the NCR.

endpoints.semantics: Replaces only the body region. The header, the navigation and any open dialog stay as they are. Not called while the page holds an unsaved entry.
